step1_analysis.description: A fully differential PMOS-input amplifier with NMOS current source loads. It includes a common-source tail current and a replica bias branch.

paper_reference.title: Analog CMOS from 5 Micrometer to 5 Nanometer Willy Sansen

sky130_expected.reasoning: Typical intrinsic gain for a single-stage differential pair in 130nm is around 30-40dB depending on the exact bias current and channel length.
With a 100fF load and ~100uA/V gm in SKY130, the UGF is expected to be in the hundreds of MHz, lower than the highly scaled nodes reported in the review paper.

phase_margin.description: Phase margin at unity gain frequency

sky130_expected.reasoning: As a single-stage amplifier with the dominant pole at the output, it should exhibit nearly 90 degrees of phase margin.
Assuming a 20uA bias current, the total current (tail + bias branches) is around 80uA from a 1.8V supply.

slew_rate.description: Maximum rate of change of the differential output voltage

sky130_expected.reasoning: A 20uA tail current charging a 100fF load capacitance yields approximately 200 V/us.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench for measuring DC gain, UGF, phase margin, power, and slew rate of the fully differential amplifier. Includes an ideal CMFB to stabilize the output common-mode voltage.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Testbench for Fully Differential Amplifier
.lib "sky130_fd_pr/models/sky130.lib.spice" tt

.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u
.param W_xm6=5u L_xm6=0.5u
.param W_xm7=5u L_xm7=0.5u
.param W_xm8=5u L_xm8=0.5u
.param W_xm9=5u L_xm9=0.5u
.param W_xm10=5u L_xm10=0.5u
.param W_xm11=5u L_xm11=0.5u

XM1 N2 N1 N6 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 N0 LABEL_NET_1 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 N5 N1 N6 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 N2 LABEL_NET_2 N0 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM5 N4 N1 N6 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}
XM6 N3 N1 N6 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm6} w={W_xm6}
XM7 N3 LABEL_NET_3 N0 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm7} w={W_xm7}
XM8 N4 N4 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm8} w={W_xm8}
XM9 N1 N1 N6 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm9} w={W_xm9}
XM10 N1 N1 N6 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm10} w={W_xm10}
XM11 N5 N4 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm11} w={W_xm11}

* Power and Ground
VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VN6 N6 0 0

* Bias Current for NMOS current sinks
Ibias VDD N1 20u

* Ideal CMFB to set output common-mode to 0.9V
Bcmfb LABEL_NET_1 0 V='0.9 + 1*( (v(N2)+v(N3))/2 - 0.9 )'

* Differential Inputs
Vd input_diff 0 dc 0 ac 1 pulse(-0.1 0.1 1n 100p 100p 50n 100n)
B1 LABEL_NET_2 0 V='0.9 + 0.5*v(input_diff)'
B2 LABEL_NET_3 0 V='0.9 - 0.5*v(input_diff)'

* Load Capacitance
C1 N2 0 100f
C2 N3 0 100f

* Differential output node for easy measurement
Bdiff out_diff 0 V='v(N3) - v(N2)'

.control
  * DC Operating Point and Power
  op
  let power = -i(VVDD) * 1.8
  print power

  * AC Analysis
  ac dec 100 1k 10G
  let gain_db = vdb(out_diff)
  let phase = 180/PI * cph(v(out_diff))
  
  meas ac dc_gain find gain_db at=1k
  meas ac ugf when gain_db=0 fall=1
  meas ac phase_at_ugf find phase when gain_db=0 fall=1
  
  * Transient Analysis for Slew Rate
  tran 100p 100n
  meas tran t_rise trig v(out_diff) val=-1.0 rise=1 targ v(out_diff) val=1.0 rise=1
  let sr_rise = 2.0 / t_rise
  print sr_rise
  
  quit
.endc
.end
